mapper.select: select u.user_no,u.role,u.userid,u.addr,u.name,u.phone,u.phone_verified,u.email,u.email_verified,u.birth,u.gender,u.photo,u.created_date,u.updated_date,u.is_blocked,u.points, m.grade_code,m.grade_name user_grade, mg.point_rate from users u, user_membership m, membership_grade mg where u.userid=#{user_id} and u.user_no=m.user_no and m.grade_code=mg.grade_code
select points from users where userid=#{user_id}
select m.grade_code from user_membership m, users u where u.userid=#{user_id} and u.user_no=m.user_no
select oi.*, p.main_image, o.user_id from orders_item oi, product p, orders o where oi.order_item_id=#{order_item_id} and oi.product_id=p.product_id and oi.order_id=o.order_id
mapper.insert: insert into orders_Item (order_item_id,order_id,product_id,product_name,group_deal_id,price_at_order,quantity,line_total_amount) values (ORDERS_ITEM_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{order_id}, NULLIF(#{product_id}, 0), #{product_name}, NULLIF(#{group_deal_id}, 0), #{price_at_order}, #{quantity}, #{line_total_amount})
mapper.select: select stock_qty from product_detail where product_id=#{product_id}
select * from orders where user_id=#{user_id} and order_type='normal' order by order_id desc
select * from orders where user_id=#{user_id} and order_type='groupdeal' order by order_id desc

select o.*, p.main_image, pd.grade,pd.unit_name,pd.origin_region, d.delivery_status, s.store_name, od.toss_orderid from orders_item o, product p, product_detail pd, delivery d, store s, orders od where o.order_id = #{order_id} and o.product_id = p.product_id and o.product_id = pd.product_id and p.producer_id = s.producer_id and o.order_id = od.order_id and o.order_item_id = d.order_item_id(+) order by o.line_total_amount desc
select order_item_id from orders_item where order_id=#{order_id}
select oi.*, d.delivery_status from orders_item oi, delivery d where oi.order_id=#{order_id} and oi.order_item_id=d.order_item_id(+)
select p.product_id, p.main_image from orders_item oi, product p where oi.order_id=#{order_id} and oi.product_id=p.product_id order by oi.order_item_id
SELECT u.user_no FROM ORDERS o JOIN ORDERS_ITEM oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN USERS u ON o.user_id = u.userId WHERE oi.order_item_id = #{order_item_id}
